name: nyc_dog_bites
description: Reported dog bite incidents in New York City (NYC DOHMH). PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "dog bites in [borough]", "dog bite statistics NYC", "how many dog bites in Brooklyn this year". Data is published in periodic batches and can lag several months — if a date filter returns nothing, this tool automatically falls back to the most recent available rows and says so.

borough.description: Optional borough filter, e.g. "Brooklyn", "Manhattan", "Queens", "Bronx", "Staten Island". Case-sensitive exact match.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) — only bites on/after this date. Omit for the most recent available regardless of date.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: nyc_dog_licences_by_breed
description: NYC licensed-dog counts by breed, or the most common breeds overall, from the NYC Dog Licensing Dataset. Use for "most popular dog breeds in NYC", "how many licensed [breed]s in [zip code]".

breed.description: Optional breed filter (partial match, case-insensitive), e.g. "Labrador", "Pit Bull".

top.description: Number of top breeds to return when no breed filter is given (1-100, default 20).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: nyc_search_animal
description: Look up a licensed NYC dog by name (partial match), optionally scoped to a ZIP code. Returns license records from the NYC Dog Licensing Dataset.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.
